mechanics.claim: Passively, Mordekaiser stores a portion of the post-mitigation damage he deals and pre-mitigation damage he takes as Potential Shield, up to a cap based on max health.
mechanics.quote: '''Mordekaiser''' stores {{fd|{{#var:dam_dealt}}}}% of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} damage he deals and {{fd|{{#var:dam_taken}}}}% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage he takes

mechanics.claim: The active consumes all stored Potential Shield and grants a shield of that amount, which decays exponentially over 4 seconds.
mechanics.quote: '''Mordekaiser''' consumes his ''Potential Shield'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration.

mechanics.claim: Indestructible can be recast (after 0.5s) while the shield from the active is up; the recast consumes the remaining shield to heal for a portion of it.
mechanics.quote: ''Indestructible'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the shield is active.

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast count as separate ability activations for on-cast trigger effects.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins only after the shield effect (and any recast) has resolved, not on initial cast.
Potential Shield gain from non-champion sources is reduced to 25% of the normal amount.
mechanics.quote: reduced to {{ap|{{#var:dam_dealt}}*{{#var:minion}}}}% of damage dealt and {{ap|{{#var:dam_taken}}*{{#var:minion}}}}% of damage taken for non-champion sources
